|---|---:|---|
| `compact` | 40 | Forty primary workflow tools for model-driven dynamic reverse engineering. |
| `inspect` | 138 | Read-only inspection and validation tools. |

| `full` | 296 | All registered tools; backward-compatible discovery surface. |
